title: The middle tier splits by -include, not by a third devkit.toml key
An installable belongs to the kit whose artifact it acts on
One ladder: [verify] names which rung each composition is, rather than a second set of commands
The sequencing question is answered by dispositioning, not by choosing an order
D8/D9/D10 report over every in_progress milestone, rather than the engine picking one
The two engine verbs get built, and the inference census is their acceptance test
The ledger keeps its frozen keys and gains category keys beside them
Everything is just a check: no belt step ever halts, and exit 2 belongs to the reader
A composition rung's cost is UNKNOWN until the composition opens its own slot, and the criterion says so
The test tier is the ladder's bottom rung, and a tier that got slower is a finding
